data.narrative:
Lodge Systems is a pre-seed stage company in the Defense & Security sector. The comp universe comprises 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers, with top-tier private comparables including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems. The sector contains 23 same-sector peers overall.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this valuation. The Defense & Security universe lacks sufficient narrow-stage comparables: zero same-stage peers, one adjacent-stage peer, and zero similar-tier peers were identified—falling short of the three-datapoint minimum required for reliable triangulation. Applying an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable methodological bias given the specialized nature of defense technology valuations and the heterogeneity of capital efficiency, regulatory dynamics, and exit multiples across stages.

Without viable quantitative triangulation anchors, this analysis cannot support a specific valuation range based on the provided data. Progression toward valuation would require either (i) deeper diligence on stage-comparable private fundraises within the Defense & Security space not captured here, (ii) qualitative reference to the identified top-tier peers (Anduril, Helsing, Shield AI) to establish relative positioning, or (iii) application of venture-stage cost-of-capital and dilution modeling if cap table and burn metrics are available. The primary uncertainty is the absence of pre-seed stage pricing signals in this sector.
